pages.lesson:
LESSON: SARUFI 4.4.1 NYAKATI NA HALI MAZOEA TIMILIFU

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya hali ya mazoea na timilifu
2. kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini
3. kutumia hali ya mazoea na timilifu ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya hali ya mazoea na timilifu
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya hali ya mazoea na timilifu. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia hali ya mazoea na timilifu ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia hali ya mazoea na timilifu ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya hali ya mazoea na timilifu

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali mazoea timilifu important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya hali ya mazoea na timilifu
2. kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini
3. kutumia hali ya mazoea na timilifu ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
